video_title: How can the Miami Heat best build around Giannis Antetokounmpo? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo's pivotal role in Team USA's 2024 success
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo was a huge part of the 2024 Team USA squad.
quotes.quote: We have talked about how LeBron James thrived alongside Stephen Curry with Team USA, and as long as we are going to point out the connections to Team USA with the Warriors, we should point out the connections to Team USA with the Miami Heat. Bam Adebayo was a huge part of the 2024 Team USA squad, and Erik Spoelstra and LeBron James really bonded during that summer. Whatever bygones that existed from his departure from the Heat were left as bygones.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins challenges Bam Adebayo to reach superstar status
quotes.excerpt: It's time for Bam to take that leap.
quotes.quote: We all keep asking for more when it comes to the Heat, but when are we going to actually address the elephant in the room? We have been watching franchise players, generational players be on the move. The Heat organization has come out publicly time and time again and said that Bam Adebayo is untouchable. It's time for Bam to take that leap. We know that Giannis Antetokounmpo is going to go out there and give you 28 to 30 a night. Can Bam go out there and give you 25 to 26 average? The 19 points and 20 points average that he has been doing throughout his career as a Miami Heat player, that's okay, but this isn't 2006, this isn't 2007. They have invested time and time again a lot of money into Bam and rightfully so. We keep saying there's a ceiling and there's potential. Bam broke Kobe Bryant's 81-point game record this year and he got more criticism than he actually did flowers. It's time for Bam to turn those boos into cheers. This is a moment for Bam.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Jr. signing provides necessary shooting for Miami
quotes.quote: The Tim Hardaway Jr. signing is tremendous for one year, $6.5 million. He was second in six-man last year. They needed shooting, shooting, shooting. They retained Patty Mills, and he was important; they did not want to put him in the Giannis trade. They signed Simone Fontecchio today. They are building this around the margins. That is what they have to do. They have a little bit of money; if LeBron James says, you know what, $6 million, I want to come to Miami, they are going to find $6 million to go there. They need a backup big for Bam, they need a backup point guard here. So there is still some moves out there.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential fit in a Miami Heat offense
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is going to have to assimilate a 3-and-D role almost.
quotes.quote: LeBron is going to have to assimilate a 3-and-D role almost, to speak, but he is just going to end up changing it because he still does his point-forward thing. The thing that scares me is just who is going to be the other guy that is shooting. I wouldn't put that on Donovan Mitchell to just say become a three-point shooter. I like for guys around LeBron for that truly to be them because if it is truly you and that is what you do, he knows how to highlight it, he knows how to bring that out. I think Giannis, we don't talk about it a lot, but Giannis is also one of those guys that is a willing passer that can activate a guy as long as he sees it fit. If he sees it that you are a shooter, a knockdown shooter, he will use you to get somebody out his way. I think that is a match made in heaven if they can get another.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' evolution into an off-ball offensive threat
quotes.excerpt: He allowed Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves throughout the regular season to be the ball-dominant guys.
quotes.quote: The one bright spot that LeBron James could take away from this past season of being with the Lakers is showing that he had a rehearsal of knowing how to take a step back and play off the ball, because he allowed Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves throughout the regular season to be the ball-dominant guys. So we saw more LeBron James running deep seals, more LeBron James cutting. We saw more LeBron James playing in the slot, waiting to be a catch-and-shoot guy, which he has improved throughout the course of the last three to four years. So LeBron, you are talking about one of the most complete basketball players in NBA history. You could drop him off at LA Fitness, the Wellness Center, the YMCA, he is going to fit regardless of where he is playing at. So, you know, you add LeBron to that roster, it is definitely an upgrade.
